---
title: "Volume III"
subtitle: "Agentic Machine Learning Systems"
---

Lecture decks for Volume III, which covers machine learning systems whose unit of work is a trajectory, a sequence of model calls, tool actions, and state that unfolds over many steps. Every lecture comes as a PDF for projection, a PowerPoint file whose notes pane holds the speaker notes, and the LaTeX source.
